notes.title: Update v.1.4.44.89
notes.content:
[b]Hello all Microbes and Machines players![/b]
In this update v.1.4.44.89 some very important things were done that I had noted based on your feedbacks.

[b]Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Added screen resolution options
[*] Added option to enable/disable screen shake effect
[*] Added new smooth camera system
[*] Balancing damage and bullet velocity on some weapons
[*] added glow effect
[/list]

[b]bugs[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where skins would not unlock in the endgame leaderboard
[/list]

Thank you to all the players and the staff who sent in the feedback. Thank you very much!! ^-^
Coming soon...a new game...

notes.title: New update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42593104/81a24cede6f21d935b61c523ec9621aec3324a30.png[/img]

[b]Improvements made[/b]

[list]
[*] The scoring system for a lost match has been improved.
[*] Now the player can unlock new main weapons, support weapons and advanced upgrades.
[*] The game's final score has also been modified.
[*] The player will be able to unlock new optional skins and bosses after completing the game.
[*] Weapon support appears in all starting rooms in any level.
[*] Added 5 more new achievements.
[*] Added sound effects for, chests, bomb item, among others.
[*] Now, every time the main weapon runs out of energy, a projectile will fall from the weapon to notify the player that they need to release the fire button to reload.
[*] Now all achieved achievements will be shown in the upper right corner of the screen.
[*] Now the name and description of each achievement will be shown at the cursor position.
[*] New main weapons and support weapons have been added.
[*] Some effects and particles on enemy death have been improved.
[/list]

Note: During my work on this update, some bugs were found that were fixed, but others may end up appearing so your feedback is very important.

Thank you very much!!(^-^)!!
